Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown

the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-openclaw-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u079/system/state/workspace/programs/task-7ad04219.py",
 "content": "from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    # Uniform separator lines split the picture into independent tiles.
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    tiles = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds) - 1):
        r0, r1 = row_bounds[ri] + 1, row_bounds[ri + 1]
        if r0 >= r1:
            continue
        row = []
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds) - 1):
            c0, c1 = col_bounds[ci] + 1, col_bounds[ci + 1]
            if c0 < c1:
                row.append([grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)])
        if row:
            tiles.append(row)
    counts = Counter(x for row in tiles for tile in row for x in tile)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[1 if sum(x != background for x in tile) == 2 else background
             for tile in row] for row in tiles]
"
}
